title: Car bomb strikes governor’s office in Meta, Colombia
html:
Car bomb strikes governor’s office in Meta, Colombia

A car bomb exploded in the city of Villavicencio in Colombia’s Meta Department. The attack was next to the governor’s office and caused extensive damage to nearby buildings.

Published On 24 Nov 2026
summary: A car bomb exploded in the city of Villavicencio in Colombia’s Meta Department.
